text: 很多视频有前三秒这种文字博取留存率，是不是也是一个技巧 (boss shared a TikTok example: on-screen text "DONT show this to a toothless fan👀" in the first frame, 102k likes, 9064 saves)

你记下来吧，属于爆款的某一点技巧 — boss classifies the first-3-seconds on-screen text hook (e.g. "DONT show this to a toothless fan👀": big one-line text from frame one, curiosity gap, readable muted, paired with an instant visual reaction) as one technique of viral videos; wants it kept as a viral technique.
还有个完播率的问题，很多视频故意勾着人们的悬念不放，持续或悬念结局在结尾 — boss notes a second viral technique for completion rate: hold the suspense through the whole video and only pay off (or reveal the ending) at the very end.

所以其实也是针对平台的规则，即什么条件会让视频继续推流 — boss frames the hook (first 3s retention) and end-suspense (completion rate) techniques as optimizing for the platform signals that decide whether a video keeps getting pushed to more viewers.

endy_nap lip-sync research: whisper word starts were up to 0.2 s off (to-DAY opened 0.2 s early) and the held I stayed open through a silence at 4.0-4.3. Retimed the 5 accents (THINGS, DAY, KNOW, DID, I) to the vocal onsets measured from the song, cross-checked against when the goose beak opens in the reference (13 short opens of 0.1-0.15 s, each 0-0.05 s after the onset). Lesson: time lip-sync from measured audio onsets, open 1 frame early, never hold the mouth open through a silence.

endy_nap: boss picked option B. Added P1h half-open mouth (0.5 credits); mouth now goes closed, half (1 frame), open, half (2 frames), closed on each of the 5 accents. Half-open frame shows a tiny hint of teeth, only visible for 1-3 frames.

endy_nap lip-sync v4 (boss idea): every sung syllable moves the mouth, stressed ones open fully, weak ones half-open; onsets measured from the song. Found the real cause of the mismatch: engine/tools/assemble.py shows the picture 2 frames (66 ms) late (frame 0 at pts 0.033 plus a 1-frame shift). Compensated in render_picture.py (AV_LAG); verified in final.mp4 that each mouth onset now lands 0-1 frame before its sound.

endy_nap: boss 10-17 decided the mouth stays closed the whole time (lip-sync never looked right). Endy just bobs to the song. Lesson: two or three still mouth frames cannot sell lip-sync to a sung track; next time either skip it from the start or plan a real lip-sync video model in the budget.
endy_nap: boss spotted a chunk of mustard cushion between the chin and the scarf knot. Removed the cushion-coloured pixels there that touch the background; the shell is left intact. 0 credits.

endy_nap mouth v5 (boss): while singing, the mouth opens and closes at a steady 0.3 s cycle (half a beat) and only stops at real breaks in the voice (sung 0.20-4.10 and 4.36-4.55). This read better to the boss than per-syllable sync; a steady flap is the default for sung tracks from now on. Outbox put on hold while re-rendering.
